objects.name: uq_current_coach_proposal_owner_domain
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_current_coach_proposal_owner_domain ON coach_mission_proposals (owner_user_id, domain_key) WHERE is_current = 1

objects.name: ai_domain_analyses
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE ai_domain_analyses ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, domain_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, baseline_id INTEGER NOT NULL, baseline_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, idempotency_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, attempt_number INTEGER NOT NULL, prompt_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, prompt_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, evidence_schema_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, evidence_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, provider VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, model VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, routing_json TEXT NOT NULL, settings_json TEXT NOT NULL, request_id VARCHAR(255), input_tokens INTEGER, output_tokens INTEGER, latency_ms INTEGER, raw_response_hash VARCHAR(64), structured_output_json TEXT, validation_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, validation_errors_json TEXT NOT NULL, failure_reason_code VARCHAR(80), supersedes_analysis_id INTEGER, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_ai_domain_analysis_attempt UNIQUE (idempotency_key, attempt_number), FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), FOREIGN KEY(baseline_id) REFERENCES coach_evidence_baselines (id), FOREIGN KEY(supersedes_analysis_id) REFERENCES ai_domain_analyses (id) )

objects.name: analysis_runs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE analysis_runs ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32), mode VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, window_start DATETIME, window_end DATETIME, source VARCHAR(80), selected_metric_snapshot_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, analysis_scope_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) )

objects.name: app_settings
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE app_settings ( "key" VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key") )

objects.name: coach_domain_slots
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE coach_domain_slots ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, domain_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, baseline_id INTEGER, current_analysis_id INTEGER, current_proposal_id INTEGER, state_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_coach_domain_slot_owner_domain UNIQUE (owner_user_id, domain_key), FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), FOREIGN KEY(baseline_id) REFERENCES coach_evidence_baselines (id), FOREIGN KEY(current_analysis_id) REFERENCES ai_domain_analyses (id), FOREIGN KEY(current_proposal_id) REFERENCES coach_mission_proposals (id) )

objects.name: coach_evidence_baselines
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE coach_evidence_baselines ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, analysis_cutoff DATETIME NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, baseline_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, evidence_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, match_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, lineage_json TEXT NOT NULL, exclusions_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_coach_evidence_baseline_hash UNIQUE (baseline_hash), FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) )

objects.name: coach_hypotheses
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE coach_hypotheses ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, analysis_run_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, source_insight_card_id VARCHAR(120), problem TEXT NOT NULL, evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, confidence FLOAT, caveats_json TEXT NOT NULL, recommended_focus TEXT NOT NULL, mission_readiness_json TEXT NOT NULL, target_metric_candidates_json TEXT NOT NULL, source_card_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(analysis_run_id) REFERENCES analysis_runs (id), FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) )

objects.name: coach_mission_proposals
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE coach_mission_proposals ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, domain_key VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, analysis_id INTEGER NOT NULL, baseline_id INTEGER NOT NULL, proposal_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, provenance_json TEXT NOT NULL, is_current BOOLEAN NOT NULL, superseded_by_id INTEGER, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(owner_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), UNIQUE (analysis_id), FOREIGN KEY(analysis_id) REFERENCES ai_domain_analyses (id), FOREIGN KEY(baseline_id) REFERENCES coach_evidence_baselines (id), UNIQUE (proposal_hash), FOREIGN KEY(superseded_by_id) REFERENCES coach_mission_proposals (id) )

objects.name: coach_missions
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE coach_missions ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, hypothesis_id INTEGER, user_id INTEGER, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, focus TEXT NOT NULL, source_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, activated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, ended_at DATETIME, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(hypothesis_id) REFERENCES coach_hypotheses (id), FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) )

objects.name: coach_recommendations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE coach_recommendations ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, priority VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, started_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, ended_at DATETIME, target_period_matches INTEGER NOT NULL, baseline_period_matches INTEGER NOT NULL, baseline_metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL, target_metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL, success_rules_json TEXT NOT NULL, failure_rules_json TEXT NOT NULL, baseline_match_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, coach_comment TEXT, created_by VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, start_after_match_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id) )

objects.name: coach_reports
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE coach_reports ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, period_start DATETIME, period_end DATETIME, matches_count INTEGER NOT NULL, report_markdown TEXT NOT NULL, report_json TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, report_type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'rule_based' NOT NULL, source_ref VARCHAR(500), user_id INTEGER, source_metric_snapshot_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id) )

objects.name: demo_duels
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE demo_duels ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, match_id INTEGER NOT NULL, round_number INTEGER NOT NULL, tick INTEGER, attacker_name VARCHAR(255), attacker_steamid VARCHAR(32), victim_name VARCHAR(255), victim_steamid VARCHAR(32), assister_name VARCHAR(255), assister_steamid VARCHAR(32), weapon VARCHAR(120), headshot INTEGER NOT NULL, opening_duel INTEGER NOT NULL, trade_kill INTEGER NOT NULL, distance FLOAT, raw_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES matches (id) )

objects.name: demo_parse_artifacts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE demo_parse_artifacts ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, match_id INTEGER NOT NULL, parser_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, parser_version VARCHAR(80), payload_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, source_demo_file VARCHAR(500), demo_sha1 VARCHAR(64), parsed_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, event_counts_json TEXT NOT NULL, confidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, data_gaps_json TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL, import_job_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_demo_parse_artifacts_match_id UNIQUE (match_id), FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES matches (id) )

objects.name: demo_player_rounds
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE demo_player_rounds ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, match_id INTEGER NOT NULL, round_number INTEGER NOT NULL, player_name VARCHAR(255), player_steamid VARCHAR(32), team_side VARCHAR(10), kills INTEGER NOT NULL, deaths INTEGER NOT NULL, assists INTEGER NOT NULL, damage INTEGER NOT NULL, utility_damage INTEGER NOT NULL, headshots INTEGER NOT NULL, flash_assists INTEGER NOT NULL, enemies_flashed INTEGER NOT NULL, opening_kill INTEGER NOT NULL, opening_death INTEGER NOT NULL, survived INTEGER NOT NULL, kast INTEGER NOT NULL, raw_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES matches (id) )

objects.name: demo_rounds
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE demo_rounds ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, match_id INTEGER NOT NULL, round_number INTEGER NOT NULL, start_tick INTEGER, freeze_end_tick INTEGER, end_tick INTEGER, winner_side VARCHAR(10), end_reason VARCHAR(80), bomb_planted_tick INTEGER, bomb_site VARCHAR(20), bomb_outcome VARCHAR(40), raw_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_demo_round_match_round UNIQUE (match_id, round_number), FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES matches (id) )

objects.name: demo_weapon_stats
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE demo_weapon_stats ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, match_id INTEGER NOT NULL, player_name VARCHAR(255), player_steamid VARCHAR(32), weapon VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, shots INTEGER NOT NULL, hits INTEGER NOT NULL, kills INTEGER NOT NULL, deaths INTEGER NOT NULL, damage INTEGER NOT NULL, headshots INTEGER NOT NULL, accuracy FLOAT, headshot_percent FLOAT, raw_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES matches (id) )

objects.name: import_jobs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE import_jobs ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, provider VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, job_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, steam_account_id INTEGER, requested_payload_json TEXT, result_json TEXT, error_message TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, started_at DATETIME, finished_at DATETIME, user_id INTEGER, logical_target_key VARCHAR(500), updated_at DATETIME, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(steam_account_id) REFERENCES steam_accounts (id) )

objects.name: match_recommendation_evaluations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE match_recommendation_evaluations ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, recommendation_id INTEGER NOT NULL, match_id INTEGER NOT NULL, evaluated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, score INTEGER NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL, positive_signals_json TEXT NOT NULL, negative_signals_json TEXT NOT NULL, coach_comment TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_match_recommendation_evaluation UNIQUE (recommendation_id, match_id), FOREIGN KEY(recommendation_id) REFERENCES coach_recommendations (id), FOREIGN KEY(match_id) REFERENCES matches (id) )

objects.name: matches
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE matches ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, source VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, external_match_id VARCHAR(255), demo_file VARCHAR(500), played_at DATETIME, map_name VARCHAR(80), mode VARCHAR(80), result VARCHAR(20), rounds_for INTEGER, rounds_against INTEGER, kills INTEGER, deaths INTEGER, assists INTEGER, kd FLOAT, adr FLOAT, kast FLOAT, rating FLOAT, headshot_percent FLOAT, entry_kills INTEGER, entry_deaths INTEGER, flash_assists INTEGER, utility_damage INTEGER, enemies_flashed INTEGER, clutches_won INTEGER, clutches_lost INTEGER, side_t_rounds_won INTEGER, side_t_rounds_lost INTEGER, side_ct_rounds_won INTEGER, side_ct_rounds_lost INTEGER, raw_json TEXT, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, early_deaths INTEGER, swing_score FLOAT, user_id INTEGER, steam_account_id INTEGER, import_job_id INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_matches_source_external_id UNIQUE (source, external_match_id) )

objects.name: metric_snapshots
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE metric_snapshots ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, owner_user_id INTEGER REFERENCES users(id), match_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES matches(id), player_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, player_name VARCHAR(255), player_steamid VARCHAR(32), source VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, metric_domain VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy', semantic_version VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0.0', scope VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'player_match', validation_status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_unverified', implementation_version VARCHAR(120), input_event_hash VARCHAR(64), source_parser_artifact_id INTEGER REFERENCES demo_parse_artifacts(id), source_event_set_id VARCHAR(255), metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL, confidence_baseline_json TEXT NOT NULL, caveats_json TEXT NOT NULL, metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_metric_snapshot_semantic_identity UNIQUE ( owner_user_id, match_id, player_key, metric_domain, semantic_version, source, source_event_set_id ) )

objects.name: mission_criteria
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE mission_criteria ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, mission_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32), metric_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, direction VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, baseline_value FLOAT, target_value FLOAT, min_sample_matches INTEGER, min_sample_rounds INTEGER, confidence_required FLOAT, rule_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(mission_id) REFERENCES coach_missions (id), FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) )

objects.name: mission_progress_evaluations
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE mission_progress_evaluations ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, mission_id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER, owner_steam_id VARCHAR(32), evaluation_window_start DATETIME, evaluation_window_end DATETIME, status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, confidence FLOAT, caveats_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), FOREIGN KEY(mission_id) REFERENCES coach_missions (id), FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) )

objects.name: steam_accounts
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE steam_accounts ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, user_id INTEGER, steam_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, persona_name VARCHAR(120), profile_url VARCHAR(500), avatar_url VARCHAR(500), linked_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, last_sync_at DATETIME, sync_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, match_auth_code VARCHAR(255), last_share_code VARCHAR(255), created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_steam_accounts_steam_id UNIQUE (steam_id), FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) )

objects.name: users
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE users ( id INTEGER NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(120), created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(255), password_hash VARCHAR(500), is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL, last_login_at DATETIME, PRIMARY KEY (id) )
